output.summary: An annual, erect or climbing legume of uncertain origin; West Africa is its centre of cultivated diversity, while its domestication remains debated. It has smooth cylindrical pods containing many seeds, whose colours and pod lengths vary among cultivated forms. Edible-seeded varieties are grown for food, including mature or green beans in northeastern Brazil and grain for human consumption in Portugal.
output.edibilityNote: Cultivated varieties have edible seeds; beans are eaten mature or green in Brazil, while Portugal grows the grain for human consumption.
